newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Telecom expects Unisource announcement today.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Telecom expects Unisource announcement today.

text.p: A spokesman for Switzerland's state-owned telecommunications provider Telecom PTT said an announcement was expected later today from Unisource.
He declined to give further details on what the announcement would say.

The Unisource partnership, linking Swiss Telecom PTT, Koninklijki PTT Nederland, Telia of Sweden and U.S. group AT&T Corp, were reported to be poised to announce a merger of their carriers, according to an article in Wednesday's Financial Times.
"There will be an announcement today," said Sepp Huber, Telecom PTT spokesman.
"We will be providing information later. It will be a Unisource announcement," he said.
